caption:
Walking lunges on every leg day, and Lulu's knees aren't keen? Knees are usually well able to handle lunges. A few tweaks often make them feel smoother.

Your knee travelling past your toes is normal for most people. Try a slightly longer stride so your hip shares the work, and lower over two or three seconds instead of dropping onto the back knee.

If full depth is sore, go halfway or hold a rail, or start with reverse lunges and build back over a few weeks. Swelling, locking, giving way or pain that lingers for days is worth an assessment.
